title: Velodrome 2028
tagline: Olympic track cycling on 42-degree banking, and it never ends.
blurb: A sold-out velodrome, a 333 metre board track banked at 42 degrees through the bends, and a keirin that never finishes. Every lap another national sprinter rolls off the line on a disc-wheeled bike, faster and hungrier than the last, so hold your line, dodge the foam blocks, the loose wheels and the weaving derny, and grab the golden GM.
